species: Using single-particle cryo–electron microscopy (cryo-EM), we solved the structures of full-length MSP-1 from P. falciparum, the deadliest and most prevalent of the Plasmodium spp. infecting humans.
sample_source: MSP-1 was produced recombinantly in Escherichia coli and purified under GMP-compatible conditions by Biomeva GmbH (Heidelberg, Germany) using the P. falciparum MSP-1D construct described by Kauth et al..
cell_line: each was expressed individually in E. coli W3110-Z1 and recovered as inclusion bodies.
strain: using the previously described MSP-1D construct based on the P. falciparum strain 3D7.
